Summary

COUSR03C is a CICS online program within the CardDemo application that provides the functionality to delete a user record from the USRSEC security file. The program presents a user deletion screen, allows an operator to look up a user by User ID, displays the user's details for confirmation, and upon pressing PF5, permanently removes the user record from the system. This is a Main/Driver program that manages its own screen interactions and navigation flow.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS File (USRSEC) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Initialize Delete User Screen - When the user deletion screen is first accessed, initialize the screen display and pre-populate the User ID field if a user was already selected from a previous screen, then display the user deletion screen 2: Validate User ID Entry - When the user presses Enter or initiates a delete, validate that the User ID field is not empty; if empty, display an error message 'User ID can NOT be empty...' and prompt the user to enter a valid User ID 3: Look Up User Details - Search for the entered User ID in the user security file; if found, retrieve and display the user's first name, last name, and user type on the screen along with a prompt message 'Press PF5 key to delete this user...' 4: Display User Not Found Error - If the entered User ID does not exist in the user security file, display an error message 'User ID NOT found...' and allow the user to enter a different User ID 5: Display User Details for Confirmation - After successfully finding the user, display the user's information (User ID, First Name, Last Name, User Type) on the screen so the administrator can confirm before deletion 6: Delete User Record - When the user presses PF5, validate the User ID is not empty, look up the user in the security file, and permanently delete the user record from the user security file 7: Confirm Successful User Deletion - After successfully deleting the user, clear all screen fields, display a green success message 'User [UserID] has been deleted...' to confirm the deletion was completed 8: Clear Screen Fields - When the user presses PF4, clear all input fields on the screen (User ID, First Name, Last Name, User Type) and reset the screen to its initial empty state 9: Navigate to Previous Screen - When the user presses PF3, return to the screen that originally called this program (or default to the Admin Menu screen COADM01C if no originating program is recorded) 10: Navigate to Admin Menu - When the user presses PF12, navigate directly to the Admin Menu screen (COADM01C) 11: Handle Invalid Key Press - When the user presses any key other than the supported function keys, display an error message indicating an invalid key was pressed and redisplay the current screen 12: Populate Screen Header Information - On every screen display, populate the screen header with the application title, program name, transaction ID, current date, and current time 13: Redirect Unauthenticated Session - If the program is accessed without an active session (no communication area), redirect the user to the sign-on screen (COSGN00C)

PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF4 PERFORM CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF5 PERFORM DELETE-USER-INFO WHEN DFHPF12 MOVE 'COADM01C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN END-EVALUATE END-IF END-IF ``` 2. SEND SCREEN (SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN): ```cobol SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN. PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COUSR3AO EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COUSR3A') MAPSET('COUSR03') FROM(COUSR3AO) ERASE CURSOR END-EXEC. ``` 3. RECEIVE SCREEN (RECEIVE-USRDEL-SCREEN): ```cobol RECEIVE-USRDEL-SCREEN. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COUSR3A') MAPSET('COUSR03') INTO(COUSR3AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. ``` 4. POPULATE HEADER FIELDS (POPULATE-HEADER-INFO): ```cobol POPULATE-HEADER-INFO. MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF COUSR3AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF COUSR3AO MOVE WS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF COUSR3AO MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO PGMNAMEO OF COUSR3AO MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF COUSR3AO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF COUSR3AO. ``` 5. PROCESS ENTER KEY - FETCH USER (PROCESS-ENTER-KEY): ```cobol PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. EVALUATE TRUE WHEN USRIDINI OF COUSR3AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'User ID can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR3AI PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR3AI CONTINUE END-EVALUATE IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON MOVE SPACES TO FNAMEI OF COUSR3AI LNAMEI OF COUSR3AI USRTYPEI OF COUSR3AI MOVE USRIDINI OF COUSR3AI TO SEC-USR-ID PERFORM READ-USER-SEC-FILE END-IF. IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON MOVE SEC-USR-FNAME TO FNAMEI OF COUSR3AI MOVE SEC-USR-LNAME TO LNAMEI OF COUSR3AI MOVE SEC-USR-TYPE TO USRTYPEI OF COUSR3AI PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN END-IF. ``` 6. DELETE USER - VALIDATE AND DELETE (DELETE-USER-INFO): ```cobol DELETE-USER-INFO. EVALUATE TRUE WHEN USRIDINI OF COUSR3AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'User ID can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR3AI PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR3AI CONTINUE END-EVALUATE IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON MOVE USRIDINI OF COUSR3AI TO SEC-USR-ID PERFORM READ-USER-SEC-FILE PERFORM DELETE-USER-SEC-FILE END-IF. ``` 7. READ USER FILE - DISPLAY RESULT ON SCREEN (READ-USER-SEC-FILE): ```cobol READ-USER-SEC-FILE. EXEC CICS READ DATASET (WS-USRSEC-FILE) INTO (SEC-USER-DATA) LENGTH (LENGTH OF SEC-USER-DATA) RIDFLD (SEC-USR-ID) KEYLENGTH (LENGTH OF SEC-USR-ID) UPDATE RESP (WS-RESP-CD) RESP2 (WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) MOVE 'Press PF5 key to delete this user ...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE DFHNEUTR TO ERRMSGC OF COUSR3AO PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'User ID NOT found...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR3AI PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Unable to lookup User...' EXEC CICS DELETE DATASET (WS-USRSEC-FILE) RESP (WS-RESP-CD) RESP2 (WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF COUSR3AO STRING 'User ' DELIMITED BY SIZE SEC-USR-ID DELIMITED BY SPACE ' has been deleted ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'User ID NOT found...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR3AI PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Unable to Update User...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO FNAMEL OF COUSR3AI PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN END-EVALUATE. ``` 9. CLEAR SCREEN - RESET ALL FIELDS (CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN / INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS): ```cobol CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN. PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS. PERFORM SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN. INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS. MOVE -1 TO USRIDINL OF COUSR3AI MOVE SPACES TO USRIDINI OF COUSR3AI FNAMEI OF COUSR3AI LNAMEI OF COUSR3AI USRTYPEI OF COUSR3AI WS-MESSAGE. ```
